synthetic_case: SYN-P1v3 (synthetic qualification case derived from Wang P1 SC + gain; development partition). Simulated data, not a recording.
purpose: Pipeline qualification benchmark only (v3). Hypotheses are the alternatives the v3 inversion must discriminate, drafted from the synthetic SEEG features mapped through the P1 gain. Disclosure: the same agent planted the generating map (logged before any fit), so these hypotheses are not blind; they define what the fit must rule in or out.

hypotheses.label: focal EZ in Left-Supramarginal-posterior (region 58), propagation to SC neighbours
hypotheses.basis: the 10 largest-change channels (PFG'11-12, GC'15-16, PFG'14-15, GC'14-15, PFG'12-13: 5.4-6.0 log-power units) all have region 58 as top-gain region; earliest 50% onset 8.5 s on all five

hypotheses.label: focal EZ in a neighbour (59 Left-Angular-gyrus or 55) with 58 as early propagation
hypotheses.basis: region 55 is 2nd-gain on PFG' channels (14.6 on PFG'12-13), 59/60 on GC' channels; feature onset at 2 Hz cannot separate sub-second propagation

hypotheses.label: extended EZ (58 with 59/60/55 jointly epileptogenic)
hypotheses.basis: gain overlap between neighbouring supramarginal/angular regions; a joint EZ could produce the same PC1 time course

hypotheses.label: no focal EZ among SEEG-visible regions (source outside the free set)
hypotheses.basis: control: the 122 non-free regions are fixed healthy in v3; if the true source lay outside the free set the fit would have to mimic it with visible regions

source_evidence: synthetic SEEG features (features.py, 2 Hz log power) of SYN-P1v3
P1 gain matrix and SC (A0007 PatientCase)
T0011 v2 benchmark findings (A0036 per LEAD: EZ/PZ swap, multimodality)

priors.x0_free: N(-2.5, 0.5) on 40 free regions (gain >= 25% max U top-3 SC neighbours), others fixed -2.5
priors.hypothesis_weights: uniform over H1-H3; H0 is a control

unobserved_node_assumptions: 122 regions with max |gain| < 25% of max and not among the top-3 SC neighbours of a visible region are fixed at x0 = -2.5 (healthy) but simulated; a true EZ there is not representable (H0).
discrimination_checks: posterior rank of 58 vs 59/57/60/55 by mean x0 and P(rank 1)
per-chain (mode) top regions and mean lp
L-BFGS profile: lp from the planted pattern vs the EZ<->PZ swapped patterns
arm B with P2 SC (mismatched connectome)
re-fit on T0011 SYN-P1 data (EZ 44, PZ 40, 42)
